item.title: Royal Windsor to support serving personnel and veterans through horses, plus more partnership news
item.description: Royal Windsor Horse Show is supporting Warrior Equine in 2026. The Royal Windsor Horse Show (14 to 17 May) has announced Warrior Equine as its 2026 official show charity. Warrior Equine, a non-profit community interest company (CIC), delivers equine-assisted coaching courses to armed forces personnel, veterans and emergency services workers.
